bug1_scroll.rootCauseHypothesis: The outer card (data-testid=pricing-modal) sets overflow:"hidden" together with maxHeight:"calc(100dvh - 24px)", and NOTHING in the component sets overflowY anywhere -- a plain clip-instead-of-scroll defect, not a flexbox min-height:0 trap (the content is not inside a flex column with a constrained flex child; it's a flat block directly inside the height-capped, overflow-hidden card).
bug1_scroll.confirmedByReading: Read PricingModal.tsx in full (802 lines) via the Read tool before forming this hypothesis; not guessed. Independently confirmed by the file's own pre-existing test (pricing-modal.test.tsx, 'card fits the viewport with no scrollbar'), which literally asserted overflow:hidden present AND overflow-y:auto absent -- the bug was pinned as intended behavior.
bug1_scroll.plannedFix: Set overflowY: "auto" (replacing overflow: "hidden") and add className="pe-scroll" (the codebase's shared scrollbar-styling utility, confirmed by reading src/styles/pe-tokens.css lines 425-451 -- it only styles the scrollbar, does not itself create a scroll container) directly on the same outer card.
bug1_scroll.precedentChecked: Read the sibling src/checkout/UnlockCheckoutModal.tsx, which already solves this exact shape correctly: overflowY: "auto" + className="pe-scroll" directly on its outer scrollable card, no separate sticky-header wrapper. Chose to mirror that pattern exactly rather than introduce a new sticky-header/flex-column architecture, per the dispatch's own framing ('not a redesigned control') applied consistently to the scroll fix as well as the CTA.

bug2_topCta.requirement: A CTA button at the top of the modal, mirroring 'the' existing bottom CTA -- same action, same targeting logic, not a redesigned control.
bug2_topCta.ambiguityFound: The modal has THREE tier subscription buttons at the bottom (Solo/Studio/Team) plus one unlock button -- there is no single obviously-unique 'the' bottom CTA by inspection alone.
bug2_topCta.resolution: Read the bottom CTA cell JSX: variant={tier === "studio" ? "primary" : "subtle"}. Studio is the ONLY button anywhere in the modal styled variant="primary"; every other button (Solo, Team, unlock, interval toggle non-active state) is subtle/ghost. That makes Studio the codebase's own unambiguous definition of 'the' primary CTA, independent of highlightTier/studioOnly props (which can emphasize multiple tiers simultaneously via the separate emphasize() helper and therefore cannot supply a single target).
bug2_topCta.alternativeConsidered: Target whichever tier emphasize() resolves as emphasized (e.g. highlightTier when passed) instead of hardcoding studio. REJECTED at this checkpoint: emphasize() can return true for BOTH studio and highlightTier at once (see existing test 'highlightTier emphasizes that column too'), so there is no single tier to hand a solo top CTA button in the general case. variant==="primary" is deterministic and matches the codebase's own working definition of the primary action.
